question: By what components is the ritual arrangement of mantra syllables and six limbs to be fashioned?
premises: Mantra syllables are employed in a divided form.
The six limbs constitute a component of the arrangement.
A ritual arrangement is to be fashioned from these components.
inference: The arrangement is fashioned using divided mantra syllables together with the six limbs.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic scope of the two ca particles in relation to the preceding ritual instructions is context-dependent.
plain_english: The arrangement is to be made with the divided mantra syllables and with those of the six limbs.
